description: The line plot illustrates the reliability score of SQL generation as a function of cost for three different models: 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis, labeled "Cost," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10. The y-axis, labeled "Reliability Score," is also a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90. The 3-Model Ensemble is represented by a blue line with circular markers, the 2-Model Ensemble by a red line with circular markers, and GPT-4 by a yellow line with circular markers. The 3-Model Ensemble starts with a reliability score of approximately 85 at a cost of 0 and ends with a score of around 70 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble begins with a score of about 80 and ends with a score of approximately 65. GPT-4 starts with the highest score of around 90 and shows a steep decline to a score of about 50 by the end of the cost range.
